Railway aur armed forces ki alag instructions chek karen.

Har example, hypothetical hai. Sanction aur latest order chek karen.
International travel me level 17 aur upar first class hai, level 14 se 16 business ya club
class hai, level 13 aur niche economy class hai, level 13 eku level 13 ke baraabar chek karenge.
Example, level 13 a me economy, level 14 me business.
Lekin entitlement, booking aur sanction, teen alak cheks hai.
Government paise de rahi ho, to ticket 3 authorized agents se lein.
Ye hai Balmer Lorry, Ashok Travels aur IRCTC.
Private airline bhi allowed hai, class aur sanction alak cheks hai.
Chozen 3 hour slot mein cheapest eligible fare bighin.
Non-stop preferably lein, 10% price band ki rule check karen.
Example, groob ke ek tour ke li ek hi selected agent use ho ga.
21 days pehle booking karna encouraged hai. Tour booking 72 hours se kum pehle ho, justification de.
Cancellation 24 hours se kum pehle ho, alag reason de. Example, 48 hours pehle booking per self-declaration lagega.
Journey ke baat 72 hours me completion certificate de, unauthorized booking per competent relaxation check karein.
Foreign visit ke liye competent approval aur budget pehle check karein, jaha screening committee
aur prime minister approval chahiye proposal 15 days pehle bhejhe aur 5 days se late nahi.
Example, secretary ka qualifying proposal thain par bhejhna hoga. Training aur kuch delegations
ke exceptions bhi check karein.
Kuch international bodies ya agreements mein sponsor terms apply hosakte hain.
Dono sets ki allowances automatic jordna sahi nahi hain.
Example, sponsor ne flight peki toh wahi fair dubhara claim na karein.
Visit approval, hospitality aur baaki expenses alak chek honge.
Latest MEA order jo hame mila, September 2023 ka hai. India se foreign tour par pehle 14 days
full admissible rate, next 14 days 75%, phir 60%. Example, mahan li full rate $100 hai. Qualifying
day 15 pr 75 dollars banega. Partial day aur baki adjustments alag verify karein.
Ab overseas posted officers ki specified tours ka alak schedule.
Pehle 7 days full, agli 7 days 75% uski baat 50% of the full admissible rate.
Example, 100 dollars bees per day eat hai 75, day 15 hai 50 dollars. Baaki applicable adjustment se pehli.
India aur overseas schedules ko mix mat karein.
Foreign hotel ke liye approved panel aur actual rental chek karen.
Room rental mein, service charges aur taxes bhi order mein hai.
Non-panel city mein, capital city ka relevant lowest rate chek hoga.
Non-representational training mein, hotel entitlement ek step lower hai.
Example, seminar ke liye normal panel ki lower step confirm karen.
Domestic hotel limit ko foreign hotel par copy na karen.
Hotel charge mein breakfast ho to daily allowance 10% kum. Example, 100 dollars per
sirf yeh reduction lagi to 90. State guest aur sari meals free ho to 25% rate.
Tips ke liye daily allowance ke upar extra reimbursement nahi.
Ek se zyada deductions ho to office se method confirm karein.
Foreign daily allowance mein official duty transport included nahi hai. Necessary aur reasonable
conveyance alak se chek ho sakta hai. Sanction mein ish kharch ke liye specific funds
hona bhi zaroori hai. Example, official meeting ka eligible taxi bill separately dekhain.
Sightseeing ka taxi apne aap official duty claim nahi bantha.
Karenzi conversion ke liye official M.E.A rate chek karein.
Latest MEA order jo hume mila September 2023 ka hai. Level 10 aur upar annexure ka full prescribed
rate check karen. Level 2 se 9 me copies ki percentage reading conflict karti hai. Example,
level 7 ka calculation legible official copy se verify karen. Later amendment aur departmental
adoption bhi check karen.
Ab see ya river steamer ka standard table. Level 9 aur upar highest, level 3 aur niche lowest
class. Level 6 se 8 mein 2 classes hon to lower class. Level 4 aur 5 mein 2, 3 ya 4 classes
alak dekhhen. Example, 3 classes mein level 5 ke liye middle ya second. Level 6 se 8 ke
3 class ke ismi office se puhchhen.

Level 4 aur 5 ke liye public bus, likin AC bus nahi.
Level 3 aur niche ordinary public bus wali row hai.
Listed auto ya own scooter jaisi modes ber auto rate dekhe.

Route, sanction aur proof ki baaki cheks bhi zaruri hai.

Auto ya on scooter ke liye 12 rupees per kilometre.
